interface_assumptions: Organization, Workspace, WorkspaceMember, and OrganizationMember models are NOT present in the current clara_api baseline.
Personal workspace features (WorkspaceFolder, WorkspaceChannel, WorkspaceNote) are strictly user-owned and isolated via user_id.
Multi-tenant organization structures belong to the dedicated control plane (services/control-plane) and subsequent architecture phases (PH44).
GlhsAppliedTransition.tenant_id acts as an idempotency key partition and does not constitute full organization IAM isolation.
